seo.title: Ebb — A Breathing App with a Little Pufferfish
seo.description: A breathing app for iPhone and Apple Watch with a friend in it. Ebb, a small pufferfish, puffs up as you breathe in and lets it all go as you breathe out, while the tide rises and falls. Box, 4-7-8, coherent and more, a tap at each change, your reef, widgets and Apple Health. Free, no account, no tracking.

hero.label: BREATHING
hero.title: Breathe with the tide.
text: Meet Ebb, a little pufferfish who breathes with you. Puff up slowly, let it all go, and watch the tide go out.
